source.original_text:
Attributed mathematical restatement; exact selected boundary, with internally completed adapters.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X~μ and Z~N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. These are probability laws. Put mY=comap(snd), H_P=L² classes measurable with respect to mY, P=i∘E[·|Y] and the canonical M:u↦u∘snd. Then H_P=ran(P), P is identity on H_P, and there exists an onto linear isometry e:L²(ν;ℝ)≃H_P with i e=M. There is a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized law is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)); Λ.IsCondKernel S and both Λ marginals equal ν. The same joint reflection F(x,y)=(x,2x−y) gives the involutive selfadjoint isometry U, with Uf=f∘F J-almost everywhere for every f. There is a bounded selfadjoint T on the full real L²(ν), with ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere for each u, and preserved integral. On H_P put A=PUP restricted via i and orthogonal projection, and B=(I_J−P)UPi:H_P→L²(J). Then A=eTe⁻¹ is selfadjoint and contractive, PB=0. There is a bounded positive operator Γ on the real scalar-valued L² space with Γ²=I−T². For the SAME transported Γ_P=eΓe⁻¹, positivity holds and Γ_P²=I_H_P−A²=B*B. There is q∈L²(ν;ℝ) equal to one ν-almost everywhere, with Tq=q and ⟨q,u⟩=∫u dν for every u. Set q_P=e q and H_P^0=ker⟨q_P,·⟩, with its inherited Hilbert structure. Membership is exactly zero ν-mean after e⁻¹. The SAME Γ_P annihilates q_P. Put γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη)>0. There exists Γ_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 equal under inclusion to the restriction of Γ_P, positive with Γ_0−γ I positive. Γ_0 is a unit in the algebra of bounded real operators. There exists a bounded real Inv on this SAME centered space with Inv Γ_0=Γ_0 Inv=I and ‖Inv‖≤1/γ. All probability, normalization, range, root, centering, spectral-gap, unit and inverse facts are internally derived from the original inputs; none is an additional public premise. αη=1 and rank-zero E remain legal. No inverse on full H_P is asserted. Define the actual closed conditional-mean-zero space H_perp=ker P in L²(J;ℝ), with its inherited complete Hilbert structure; this is not merely the globally zero-mean joint space. There exists B_0:H_P^0→H_perp whose inclusion equals B i_0. There exists V_0:H_P^0→H_perp with V_0=B_0 Inv, B_0=V_0 Γ_0, V_0* V_0=I and ‖V_0 f‖=‖f‖ for every f∈H_P^0. All these objects and identities are conclusions from the same original inputs. The genuine original-input consumer proves B_0* g=Γ_0 V_0* g, ‖V_0* g‖≤‖g‖ and V_0*(g−V_0 V_0* g)=0 for every g∈H_perp. No surjectivity onto H_perp or equality V_0 V_0*=I on that entire space is claimed.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    let F := fun p : E × E => (p.1,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2)
    let mY := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E)
    letI : MeasurableSpace (E × E) := Prod.instMeasurableSpace
    letI : Fact (mY ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (E × E))) :=
      ⟨measurable_snd.comap_le⟩
    let HP := lpMeas ℝ ℝ mY 2 J
    let P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
      HP.subtypeL ∘L condExpL2 ℝ ℝ (μ := J) measurable_snd.comap_le
    let hp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.snd : E × E → E) J ν := ⟨measurable_snd,rfl⟩
    let M : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.snd hp
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    HP = P.toLinearMap.range ∧
    (∀ f : HP, P (f : Lp ℝ 2 J) = f) ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ e : Lp ℝ 2 ν ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] HP,
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, (e u : Lp ℝ 2 J) = M u) ∧
        ∃ U : Lp ℝ 2 J →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J,
          (∀ g : Lp ℝ 2 J, (U g : E × E → ℝ) =ᵐ[J] g ∘ F) ∧
          Function.Involutive U ∧ IsSelfAdjoint U.toContinuousLinearMap ∧
          ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
            IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
            (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
              (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
              (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
            let A : HP →L[ℝ] HP :=
              HP.orthogonalProjectionOnto ∘L U.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L HP.subtypeL
            let B : HP →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
              (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J)-P)*U.toContinuousLinearMap*P) ∘L HP.subtypeL
            A = e.conjStarAlgEquiv T ∧ IsSelfAdjoint A ∧
            (∀ f : HP, ‖A f‖ ≤ ‖f‖) ∧
            (∀ f : HP, P (B f) = 0) ∧
            ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ=(1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T ∧
              let ΓP : HP →L[ℝ] HP := e.conjStarAlgEquiv Γ
              ΓP.IsPositive ∧ ΓP*ΓP=(1 : HP →L[ℝ] HP)-A*A ∧
              B.adjoint ∘L B = ΓP*ΓP ∧
              ∃ q : Lp ℝ 2 ν,
                (q : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧ T q = q ∧
                (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, inner ℝ q u = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
                let qP : HP := e q
                let HP0 := (innerSL ℝ qP).ker
                letI : NormedAddCommGroup HP0 := HP0.normedAddCommGroup
                letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ HP0 := HP0.innerProductSpace
                letI : CompleteSpace HP0 := (innerSL ℝ qP).isClosed_ker.completeSpace_coe
                let γ : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt ((α : ℝ)*η)/(1+(α : ℝ)*η)
                (∀ f : HP, f ∈ HP0 ↔ (∫ y, (e.symm f) y ∂ν) = 0) ∧
                ΓP qP = 0 ∧ 0 < γ ∧
                ∃ ΓP0 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0,
                  (∀ f : HP0, (ΓP0 f : HP) = ΓP (f : HP)) ∧
                  ΓP0.IsPositive ∧ (ΓP0-γ • (1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0)).IsPositive ∧
                  IsUnit ΓP0 ∧
                  ∃ Inv : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0,
                    Inv*ΓP0=(1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧
                    ΓP0*Inv=(1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧ ‖Inv‖ ≤ 1/γ ∧
                    let Hperp := P.ker
                    letI : NormedAddCommGroup Hperp := Hperp.normedAddCommGroup
                    letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ Hperp := Hperp.innerProductSpace
                    letI : CompleteSpace Hperp := P.isClosed_ker.completeSpace_coe
                    ∃ B0 : HP0 →L[ℝ] Hperp,
                      (∀ f : HP0, (B0 f : Lp ℝ 2 J) = B (f : HP)) ∧
                      ∃ V0 : HP0 →L[ℝ] Hperp,
                        V0 = B0 ∘L Inv ∧ B0 = V0 ∘L ΓP0 ∧
                        V0.adjoint ∘L V0 = (1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧
                        (∀ f : HP0, ‖V0 f‖ = ‖f‖)
decoder_context: Measure.tilted denotes normalized exponential tilting. The Gaussian product pushforward, reflected law and every-state normalized kernel are produced, with per-observable AE conditional actions.

Lp exponent2 is the complete real Hilbert space of square-integrable almost-everywhere classes. lpMeas is the closed measurable subspace for the displayed comap sigma algebra. condExpL2 is conditional expectation. The measurable-space Fact is derived internally.

Subtype maps are inclusions; the pullback isometric equivalence is produced. Isometric conjugation sends C to e C e.symm. Multiplication of bounded endomorphisms is composition; IsPositive means selfadjoint with nonnegative quadratic form.

The constant q, integral pairing, exact centered kernel HP0, positive restricted root, unit and two-sided bounded inverse are produced. Their inherited complete Hilbert structures are internal, not premises.

Hperp is the kernel of the displayed conditional-expectation operator P, not merely the globally zero-mean space. B0 and V0 are bounded real maps between the exact displayed subspaces. adjoint is the Hilbert adjoint. V0.adjoint composed V0=I asserts an isometry into Hperp; no onto or reverse-product identity is concluded.

reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner product space carrying its normed additive commutative group structure and its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E->R be twice continuously Frechet differentiable, alpha,beta be nonnegative real parameters, and eta be real. Assume 0<alpha, alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. For every x,v:E assume both
  alpha*||v||^2 <= (D(DV)(x)[v])[v],
  (D(DV)(x)[v])[v] <= beta*||v||^2.
Use real coercions of alpha,beta in these formulas. DV(x) is a bounded real-linear functional on E, and D(DV)(x)[v] is another such functional. These data, structures and inequalities exhaust the caller premises.

Define mu as the normalized exponential tilt of volume on E by x->-V(x). Define J as the pushforward of mu times stdGaussian(E) by (x,z)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*z). Set nu=J.snd. Define Lambda as the pushforward of J by (x,y)->(y,2*x-y), and F(x,y)=(x,2*x-y). Thus J uses coordinates (x,y), whereas Lambda uses coordinates (y,2*x-y).

Use the product measurable structure on E x E. Set mY=comap(second-coordinate map, the measurable structure of E); the inclusion of mY in the product sigma algebra is derived internally from measurability of that projection. Let H=L2(J) and K=L2(nu), complete real Hilbert spaces of square-integrable measurable almost-everywhere classes. Let HP=lpMeas(R,R,mY,2,J), the closed mY-measurable subspace of H, with inclusion i:HP->H and orthogonal projection pi:H->HP. Define P:H->H by inclusion composed with L2 conditional expectation onto mY. Let M:K->H be the real-linear isometric pullback by the second-coordinate map; its measure-preserving witness is derived internally from nu=J.snd.

The measures mu,J,nu are probability measures. HP is exactly the algebraic range of P.toLinearMap, and P(i(f))=i(f) for every f:HP.

There exists a Markov kernel S from E to E such that for every y:E, as an exact equality of measures,
  S(y)=volume.tilted(x->-V((y+x)/2)-||y-x||^2/(8*eta)).
This normalized formula is every-state. S is a conditional kernel of Lambda, with the second coordinate conditioned on the first in the supplied IsCondKernel sense. Lambda.fst=nu and Lambda.snd=nu.

There exists a real-linear isometric equivalence e:K->HP onto that exact subspace, with i(e(u))=M(u) for every u:K. There exists a real-linear isometry U:H->H such that, separately for every g:H, the representative of U(g) equals g composed with F J-almost everywhere. U is involutive, U(U(g))=g for every g, and U.toContinuousLinearMap is selfadjoint.

There exists a bounded real-linear endomorphism T:K->K which is selfadjoint and satisfies, for every u:K, all three statements:
  ||T(u)||<=||u||,
  T(u)(y)=integral u(x) dS(y)(x) for nu-almost every y,
